fusions.name: Gall-Ink Blot
fusions.desc: Flicks a blot of corrosive ink that deals 4 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Clasped Codex
fusions.desc: Swings a clasped codex around you that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Unyielding Covers
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you.

fusions.name: Cold Binding
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your covers close: you gain a ward of 15% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 12 seconds.
